VideoBookmark.title: VideoBookmark
VideoBookmark.description: Represents a saved video link item with AI classification, status tracking, and deletion lifecycle

url.description: Original URL of the video link

title.description: Title or summary of the video

source.description: Source platform of the video (youtube, instagram, tiktok, etc)

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the video was saved

status.description: Status of the saved video link

inTrash.description: Whether the video is currently placed in ClipSort trash

trashedAt.description: Unix timestamp when video was moved to trash

ContactInquiry.title: ContactInquiry
ContactInquiry.description: Customer support inquiry submitted from ContactSubView and processed server-side

AccountLink.title: AccountLink
AccountLink.description: Maps a secondary Firebase UID (e.g. Google or Email) to a primary unified Master UID (Kakao-first)

email.description: Email associated with the secondary account

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Unified user account metadata storing linked providers and resolved contact emails

/videos/{videoId}.description: Saved video bookmarks collection managed by ClipSort

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Server-only customer inquiries collection written by Admin SDK

/account_links/{uid}.description: Server-only mapping from secondary UIDs to primary unified UID

/user_accounts/{uid}.description: Server-only metadata for unified multi-provider accounts
